:::{#rem-surprisal-units}
#### Rarer outcomes are more surprising, and the logarithm base sets the unit

An [outcome](probability-basics.qmd#def-experiment-outcome) with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) $1$ has [surprisal](#def-surprisal) $0$,
and the surprisal grows without bound as $\P(X=x) \to 0$.
The base of the logarithm determines the unit:
nats for the natural logarithm and bits for base 2.

:::
